title: Afternoon crossover sync — UX + Analytics patch plan
content:
Attendees: Priya, Marcus, Hannah, Diego, Zoe
Date: 2026-10-22 15:00 PT (afternoon cross-team sync)
Duration: 35m
Location: #console-tooling channel + quick huddle in 4th-floor focus room

Purpose
- Lightweight cross-check before tonight's partial rollout: make sure UX changes and analytics events align and that the canary has a rollback plan.

Quick updates
- Marcus (Frontend): shipping trimmed button states for panel controls — CSS edge-case fixed (hover → active flicker). Pushed PR: GH PR #1892. Built a tiny e2e to cover the focus/keyboard path. Local smoke looks good; staging failing on one flaky test (keyboard-nav-spec).
- Hannah (Rollouts): canary window scheduled 20:00–22:00 PT. Canary sized at ~3% of traffic routed to panel v2.0. Canary health checks: latency spike threshold = +60ms, error rate threshold = 0.5%. If trigger, automated rollback to v1.9 will engage via the routing policy.
- Diego (Analytics): updated event schema for panel_open, panel_interact to include new field `ux_variant`. Need to make sure front end emits `ux_variant: "compact" | "expanded"`. Deployed schema migration on staging; one schema mismatch caught in staging logs — missing `session_id` in a couple of late-stage flows.
- Zoe (Observability / Console): dashboards created for canary: panel-latency, panel-errors, interaction-rate. Dashboard shares: /dashboards/panel-canary. Alerting: Slack webhook configured to #panel-rollouts-oncall.

Blockers / Risks
- Failing e2e (keyboard-nav-spec): Marcus suspects timing flakiness introduced by animation frame changes. Mitigation: disable animation during CI for that spec (quick patch) and file follow-up to reintroduce accessible animations. Ticket: RED-8243.
- Analytics missing session_id: Diego traced to a code path where session initialization happens after panel render in new variant. Fix: emit a guard that falls back to anonymous-session token until session resolves (low-risk).
- Rollout scheduler edge-case: canary scheduler currently doesn't account for some long-tail customers on legacy proxies; risk of uneven distribution. Hannah to validate traffic split logs before rollout.

Decisions made
- Proceed with canary tonight but gate on: green e2e run on staging (after disabling animation), session_id guard deployed to staging, and at least 2 hours of smoke traffic on staging capturing `ux_variant` for at least 100 sessions.
- Keep canary at 3% for first 2 hours, then increase to 15% if no alerts. Full ramp only after 24 hours and signoff from oncall.

Action items (owners + ETA)
- Marcus: push quick CI patch to disable animation for keyboard-nav-spec, re-run e2e (ETA: 2h).
- Diego: implement session_id guard + backfill small events so sanity dashboard shows non-empty ux_variant counts (ETA: 3h).
- Hannah: run traffic distribution check for legacy proxies and confirm effective 3% split on staging (ETA: 4h).
- Zoe: add a temporary chart that shows ux_variant breakdown by region and pipeline, add to canary dashboard (ETA: 3h).
- Priya: prepare a brief rollback runbook snippet and post it to #panel-rollouts (ETA: 90m).

Notes to self / loose thoughts
- We should avoid adding new required event fields during a rollout — prefer optional fields with clear fallbacks.
- Follow-up: consider an automated DB validation that flags missing session_id backfill candidates.
- UX question: compact variant hides some affordances — we need a short qualitative check with design before full ramp. Add to next-week design sync.

Post-meeting quick checks (done during call)
- Marcus ran local e2e and reproduced flaky test; queued CI patch.
- Diego confirmed schema change is backward compatible with prior pipeline.
- Hannah validated canary schedule; ops aware and evening oncall assigned.

Open questions (for next sync)
- If session_id backfill is partial, do we hold the rollout? (TBD)
- Should we ship compact variant telemetry as `ux_variant:compact` or `ux_variant:compact_v1` to allow later migrations? Decision leaning towards versions with migration plan.

Follow-ups scheduled
- Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm staging smoke results. Priya to send calendar invite.
- Design sync Wednesday to sign off on compact/expanded affordance tradeoffs.

Related links / artifacts:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1892
- Linear: https://linear.app/RED/issue/RED-8243/ux-flaky-button-analytics
- Dashboards: internal/dashboards/panel-canary

Endnotes
- Tone: keep this doc lightweight — capturing decisions, owners, and immediate blockers. Will copy the runbook snippet into Confluence once final.

-- Priya
